name: Rafal Modrzewski
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, ICEYE (synthetic-aperture-radar satellite company, Espoo, Finland)
profile: Polish engineer who studied electrical engineering at Warsaw University of Technology and radio science at Finland's Aalto University, where he co-founded ICEYE with Pekka Laurila as a student project. ICEYE builds and operates a constellation of small radar (SAR) satellites that image Earth day or night through cloud, serving defense, insurance and disaster-response customers; valued ~$3B.
interesting_fact: He and co-founder Pekka Laurila were named finalists for EY World Entrepreneur Of The Year 2026, representing Poland and Finland respectively.
deep_cut_fact: In 2019 he shared the Finnish Engineering Award with Laurila, Antti Kestila and Aalto professors Jaan Praks and Tuomas Tikka for creating Finland's space sector, which grew out of student course work on Aalto-1, a 'milk bottle-sized' nanosatellite.
notes: The company name reflects its original goal of monitoring Arctic sea ice. Press inquiries go through the ICEYE press contact form.

name: Chris Merrick
profile: Data-infrastructure engineer who led engineering teams at Stitch (ETL startup acquired by Talend) and then at Talend. In 2022 he co-founded Omni, an AI-driven business-intelligence platform built on a semantic layer, with college friends Colin Zima and Jamie Davidson; Omni is valued around $2B.
interesting_fact: Omni's three co-founders met in college, went separate ways (Zima and Davidson to Looker/Google, Merrick to Stitch/Talend) and reunited in 2022 to build Omni.
deep_cut_fact: He helped create the Singer and dbt open-source projects, now widely used data-engineering standards.
notes: Lower public profile than CEO Colin Zima; work email is published on Omni's team page.

name: Li Hongwei
current_role: Founder, Chairman & CEO, RayNeo (雷鸟创新, consumer AR/AI glasses, Shenzhen)
profile: Peking University computer-science graduate (2009) who worked at Cisco China and iQIYI before founding RayNeo, an AR-glasses maker incubated by TCL Electronics in 2021. RayNeo sells consumer AR and AI glasses globally and raised over 500M yuan in 2024; valued ~$1B.
interesting_fact: In July 2026 CCTV's '2026 China AI Gala' named him a 2026 AI Person of the Year, the only honoree from the smart-glasses sector.
deep_cut_fact: At iQIYI, which he joined in 2011, he built the smart-TV business from scratch, launching the iQIYI TV app, the TCL-iQIYI television and iQIYI's ultra-HD set-top box, an early link to TCL.
notes: TCL founder Li Dongsheng is the largest shareholder (27.5%) of the operating entity. No dedicated press email found; route via RayNeo website. Chinese-language outreach advisable.

name: Feng Weihua
current_role: Chairwoman, CEO & executive director, Qian Dama (钱大妈, community fresh-food retail chain, Guangzhou)
profile: Co-founder of Qian Dama, the Guangdong-born 'no overnight meat' fresh-food franchise chain founded in 2014, which raised ~1.73B yuan across six rounds through 2022. She is now the controlling shareholder (about 50.65% voting control) and led its January 2026 Hong Kong IPO filing; annual product sales reportedly exceed 10 billion yuan.
interesting_fact: Qian Dama filed for a Hong Kong listing on 12 January 2026, with backers including Gaorong Capital, Cornerstone Capital and Taikang Life.
deep_cut_fact: Before groceries she spent over seven years (from December 1997) at Foshan Shunde Hydropower Construction Engineering Co., joining just five months after it was founded, then two years at a Shunde hydropower surveying firm. Her original name was Feng Re'ai (冯热爱).
notes: Very private; little English coverage. Hydropower-engineering background could be a podcast hook. Company site (qdama.cn) is region-blocked from here; the HKEX prospectus will list an IR/press contact. Avoid family/shareholding-transfer topics.
